decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is distant from the core business and its prospects are still uncertain, but naval programs run for decades with low ongoing costs once certified, so keeping this niche option open is cheap relative to its potential follow-on value.
Explosion-proof industrial luminaires build on established competence, and the added LED replacement kit shows management is investing further, so the uncertainty has resolved in favor of commitment.

The relaunched designer task light sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep, though consumer-style design pieces have a limited life and weaker strategic fit than professional solutions, which leaves a moderate risk of pruning.
The pendant office luminaire is close to the core offer, shares production and sales channels, and is cheap to keep while its market value in office refurbishment continues to emerge.

The premium pendant line with several models is a recent, core-adjacent investment that fits the LED efficiency strategy, so it should be kept until its results show whether further commitment is justified.
